primary.description: Mark this as the primary NetworkPolicy.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the name of the policy with the release fullname.

namespace.description: Namespace of the policy. Defaults to the release namespace.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

oneOf.description: A Helm template that renders the type.

type.description: Type of policy to create. `kubernetes` creates a NetworkPolicy, `cilium` creates a CiliumNetworkPolicy and requires the Cilium CRDs

clusterwide.description: Cilium only. Create a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy instead of a CiliumNetworkPolicy, chart based selectors are pinned to the namespace of the chart

description.description: Cilium only. Free form description of the policy, supports Helm `tpl`

podSelector.description: Custom Kubernetes label selector for pods to which this policy applies.

items.description: Name of a workload of this chart.

targetSelector.description: Target one or more workloads from this chart by name.

items.description: A regular expression matched against the workload names.

targetSelectorRegex.description: Target workloads from this chart whose names match one or more regular expressions

targetAllPods.description: Target all pods in the namespace.

key.description: Label key the selector applies to.

operator.description: Relationship of the key to the values, e.g. `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists` or `DoesNotExist`.

values.description: Values of the label. Empty for `Exists` and `DoesNotExist`.

endpointSelector.description: Cilium only. Select the endpoints to which this policy applies, supports Helm `tpl`

key.description: Label key the selector applies to.

operator.description: Relationship of the key to the values, e.g. `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists` or `DoesNotExist`.

values.description: Values of the label. Empty for `Exists` and `DoesNotExist`.

nodeSelector.description: Cilium only. Host policy, select the nodes to which this policy applies instead of pods. Requires `clusterwide: true`, supports Helm `tpl`

policyTypes.description: Policy types. When omitted, types are inferred from the configured rules.

ingress.description: Put the selected endpoints in ingress default deny mode

egress.description: Put the selected endpoints in egress default deny mode

enableDefaultDeny.description: Cilium only. Control whether the policy puts the selected endpoints in default deny mode

items.description: An endpoint selector, passed on as is.

fromEntities.description: Entities the rule applies to, e.g. `world` or `cluster`.

items.description: A CIDR with exceptions, passed on as is.

fromCIDRSet.description: CIDRs with exceptions the rule applies to.

items.description: A port rule, passed on as is.
An ICMP rule, passed on as is.

icmps.description: ICMP types the rule applies to.

ingressDeny.description: Cilium only. List of ingress deny rules, these take precedence over allow rules, supports Helm `tpl`

items.description: An endpoint selector, passed on as is.

toEntities.description: Entities the rule applies to, e.g. `world` or `cluster`.

items.description: A CIDR with exceptions, passed on as is.

toCIDRSet.description: CIDRs with exceptions the rule applies to.

items.description: A port rule, passed on as is.
An ICMP rule, passed on as is.

icmps.description: ICMP types the rule applies to.

egressDeny.description: Cilium only. List of egress deny rules, these take precedence over allow rules, supports Helm `tpl`

description: A NetworkPolicy, or a CiliumNetworkPolicy with `type: cilium`.
